title: Clinical trial on the use of metformin in addition to standard therapy in patients with high-grade glioma
official: Phase 2, open-label, single-arm study on the use of metformin as adjunctive therapy in high-grade glioma
summary: Main objective: Determine efficacy at the recommended dose of metformin in patients with glioblastoma. Efficacy will be assessed by PFS at 6 months after initiation of treatment. Radiographic response will be assessed by RANO (Response Assessment in Neurooncology) criteria compared with the patient's condition at baseline (MRI performed postsurgery)
sponsor: Universita Degli Studi Di Milano Bicocca

sites.f: Fondazione IRCCS Ca Granda Ospedale Maggiore Policlinico – Neurochirurgia
